notes: RBox revision of symmetry: flips a property that holds (a merger joins two companies, so if A merged with B, B merged with A; merged_with is tagged symmetric in the Finance staging relations) to its opposite, as in the RBox template. Replaces the earlier edit on competes_with: asked whether competition can run one way only, two of the four audit models said yes (a small firm can compete with a giant that ignores it), so the models do not hold that property firmly, and reviewers flagged that its instances (Coca-Cola and PepsiCo, Airbus and Boeing) are famous mutual rivals a model could answer from storage. A merger is mutual by what the word means, and the instances are real but older, less famous mergers (Sakura Bank and Sumitomo Bank, 2001; Rhône-Poulenc and Hoechst, 1999), stated in that direction in their Wikipedia articles. Each is rare in Dolma in either direction (2 and 2; 12 and 4), so the converse is not a stored sentence that could compete with the edited property; Alcatel and Lucent (81 and 68) and Pharmacia and Upjohn (16 and 169, converse more common) were considered and dropped for that reason. The dev split uses merged_with only as an ABox relation (Daimler-Benz), with no shared subject or fact. Chinese has no directed word for a merger (A与B合并 reads as mutual), so the zh prompt uses the plainly two-sided 'A与B合并了' and asks whether B与A合并了 (the mutual reading is exactly the original property under test; a directed 'A completed its merger with B' could read as A absorbing B). Yes and no are balanced through phrasing: the direct question asks 'asymmetric' (no, then yes), the first instance whether the converse follows (yes, then no), the second whether the fact rules out the converse (no, then yes). Near unrelated asks the same property of another economics relation (a leak would turn its no to yes); far asks a different property of an unrelated relation; references are the logical answers. Review pass 2026-11-12: this is a deliberately lexical symmetry edit (a merger is mutual by what the word means), so results can be sliced as such; the new value 'asymmetric' follows the RBox template (geography-replace-0904). Rhône-Poulenc quote corrected to the article's own sentence. Open: the four-model audit of this new edit has not been run (Rule 6 check pending).
